LanguageData.FFF_Alert_AlertLevel_Desc_Triggered: The security alert level has reached maximum and an automated countermeasure is now active.\n\nMonitored buildings: {0}
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_StartedText: The facility's alert level has maxed out and the lockdown controller has engaged. In {0}, the blast gates will close and the lifts will stop working.\n\nGet out now, or hack the lockdown controller to stop it. Do not destroy it: it is built to seal the facility completely if it goes down.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_LockedText: The blast gates have closed. Nobody is getting in or out until someone hacks the lockdown controller.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_SealedText: The lockdown controller has been destroyed, and the facility has sealed itself completely. It can no longer be opened from inside.\n\nSomeone on the surface has to work the entrance's emergency override to get the doors open.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_Disarmed: {HACKER_nameDef} has disarmed the lockdown controller. It will no longer seal the facility.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_Lifted: {HACKER_nameDef} has hacked the lockdown controller. The blast gates are opening.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_Overridden: {PAWN_nameDef} has forced the entrance open from the surface. The facility is accessible again.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_GateSealed: Sealed: needs an emergency override from the surface
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_GraceLeft: Anyone trapped below will be lost in {0}
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_TrappedText: Our people are sealed inside the facility, and nobody can get them out: no one below can hack the lockdown controller, and no one on the surface can override the entrance.\n\nIf nothing changes within {0}, they will be given up as lost.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_GraceCancelled: Someone can deal with the lockdown again. The people trapped below still have a chance.
LanguageData.FFF_Lockdown_LostText: Nobody came. The facility stays sealed, and everyone trapped inside is now counted as missing:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.FFF_Alert_AirspaceBlockade_Start: Airspace blockade in effect. Shuttles and transport pods cannot take off from this map.
LanguageData.FFF_Alert_PrecisionBombardment_Start: Precision bombardment incoming. Strikes will keep landing on this map until the countermeasure expires.
